# Protect, Optimize, and Scale Your Infrastructure for AI

Confidently meet the demands of AI with solutions that secure and deliver your mission-critical
applications and networks

[ Explore Solutions ][137]

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

[ Protect Your Apps & Networks ][138]
[Security Solutions][Security Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

[ Optimize & Scale Your Infrastructure ][139]
[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]

### Centralized Management & Automation Solutions

#### Simplify operations across complex environments

Managing infrastructure across multiple clouds is becoming increasingly complex, especially for
AI‑enabled apps that demand precise capacity planning and prompt scaling.

  Enjoy unlimited bandwidth for endless access to your favorite online content.

  traffic for safer browsing, streaming, and smart home use—no need to install apps on each device.

  your credit score, scan the dark web for data leaks, and rely on 24/7 recovery services.

    other data sources to detect the illegal trading of your personal information.
  * Credit report monitoring Instant online access to your credit reports and scores from 1 bureau
    so you can spot mistakes and fraudulent activity.
  * Social media identity monitoring Monitor your Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram accounts
    for inappropriate activity and posts that could be perceived as violent.
  * Identity threat alerts Keep you updated on major data breaches, identity theft incidents, and
    new identity theft laws.

  * Lost wallet assistance Quickly cancel and replace credit, debit, and ATM cards if your wallet is

    Assistance.
  * Identity recovery + $1M insurance Restoration services from Certified Protection Experts, based
    in the U.S., who are available 24/7.

  threats, back up your data automatically, and restore everything in moments if encryption ever

Core Capabilities

## Enterprise Security Features Built In

Every [Netgate appliance][29] ships with pfSense® — the world's most trusted open-source firewall
platform.

#### Stateful Firewall

Deep packet inspection with stateful connection tracking. Block threats before they reach your
network perimeter.

#### VPN Gateway

IPsec, OpenVPN and WireGuard® support. Secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN for your workforce.

#### IDS / IPS

Snort and Suricata integration for real-time intrusion detection and prevention with auto-blocking
rules.

#### Content Filtering

Web content filtering with pfBlockerNG — block ads, trackers, malicious domains and inappropriate
content.

#### Traffic Shaping / QoS

HFSC and PRIQ traffic shaping. Prioritise voice, video and critical business applications
automatically.

#### Multi-WAN & Failover

Load balance across multiple ISP links and automatic failover — ensuring zero downtime for your
business.

#### VLAN Segmentation

Isolate networks with 802.1Q VLAN support. Separate IoT, guest, employee and PCI DSS zones
effortlessly.

#### Monitoring & Reporting

Real-time dashboards, bandwidth graphs, traffic analysis and syslog export to your SIEM platform.

#### High Availability

CARP-based HA clustering with automatic state sync. Deploy active-passive pairs for mission-critical
uptime.

## Everything You Need for Modern Network Security

### Deploy in Minutes

Connect Port0 to your EDR, identity provider, and cloud logs via API. No agents, no collectors, no
network configuration.

### Map Your Entire Network

See every identity, process, and connection across cloud and on-prem. Understand normal behavior to
detect anomalies faster.

### Detect Lateral Movement in Real Time

Alert when attackers pivot between systems. See the full attack path before they reach critical
assets.

### 24/7 Monitoring

Real-time alerts for suspicious activity. Your network is monitored around the clock.

### Maintain Compliance

Continuous monitoring and audit trails support SOC 2, ISO27001, and HIPAA requirements.

### Investigate Faster

AI-powered analysis surfaces relevant context automatically. Trace connections across weeks of
activity in minutes instead of hours.

#### Snort 3 is here!

Upgrade to experience a slew of new features and improvements.

[ Upgrade Now ][34]


What is Snort?

Snort is the foremost Open Source Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) in the world. Snort IPS uses a
series of rules that help define malicious network activity and uses those rules to find packets
that match against them and generates alerts for users.

Snort can be deployed inline to stop these packets, as well. Snort has three primary uses: As a
packet sniffer like tcpdump, as a packet logger — which is useful for network traffic debugging, or
it can be used as a full-blown network intrusion prevention system. Snort can be downloaded and
configured for personal and business use alike.

What are my options for buying and using Snort?

Once downloaded and configured, Snort rules are distributed in two sets: The “Community Ruleset” and
the “Snort Subscriber Ruleset.”

The Snort Subscriber Ruleset is developed, tested, and approved by Cisco Talos. Subscribers to the
Snort Subscriber Ruleset will receive the ruleset in real time as they are released to Cisco
customers. You can download the rules and deploy them in your network through the Snort.org website.
The Community Ruleset is developed by the Snort community and QAed by Cisco Talos. It is freely
available to all users.

For more information about Snort Subscriber Rulesets available for purchase, please visit the [Snort
product page][35].

[Get Started][36]
Step 1

#### Download and install the source code

If this is your first time installing Snort, please review the [dependencies list][37].

[https://github.com/snort3/snort3/releases][38]

You can also get the code with:

git clone https://github.com/snort3/snort3.git

There are separate extras packages for cmake that provide additional features and demonstrate how to
build plugins. The source for extras is in the [snort3_extra.git][39] repo.

Step 2

#### Sign up and get your Oinkcode - a unique identifier that must be entered into your Snort
#### instance that will automatically pull in Snort rules. All users have access to the Registered
#### Rule Set. In order to get the latest detections (Subscriber Rule Set) you can upgrade your
#### subscription at any time.

[Sign up/Subscribe][40]
Step 3

#### For video instructions and additional documents, check out our [resources][41] page.

#### You can also read the [Snort 3 instruction manual][42].

# AcrosecのWebサイトへようこそ

予防的かつ積極的なITセキュリテが気になりますでしょうか？我々にとっても大事なアプローチです。よく見ら
れる”後からの思い付き”によるITセキュリティをリリース後のソリューションを応急処置的にボルトオンするの
は、特にアプリケーション開発において、良い選択肢ではないと考えております。ICT製品の品質とそのITセキ
ュリティは関連し合い、一枚のコインの表と裏です。

アクロセック社は企業向けのITセキュリティソリューションを提供する日本法人です。取扱製品としてはスイス

略とセキュリティコンサルティング、情報セキュリティ並びにITリスクです。ご興味のある方は是非お問い合わ
せください。

Airlock
WAFはインターネット・バンキング、Eコマース、モバイル通信等、様々な業界で高く評価されています。現在、
スイスで実証されているインターネットバンキング用セキュリティのベンチマークと言っても過言ではありませ
ん。Airlock
WAFは日本の企業の重要なウェブアプリケーション並びにそのデータを保護し、高度なセキュリティレベルをも
たらします。

# AcrosecのWebサイトへようこそ

予防的かつ積極的なITセキュリテが気になりますでしょうか？我々にとっても大事なアプローチです。よく見ら
れる”後からの思い付き”によるITセキュリティをリリース後のソリューションを応急処置的にボルトオンするの
は、特にアプリケーション開発において、良い選択肢ではないと考えております。ICT製品の品質とそのITセキ
ュリティは関連し合い、一枚のコインの表と裏です。

アクロセック社は企業向けのITセキュリティソリューションを提供する日本法人です。取扱製品としてはスイス
のパートナーErgon社のハイエンド型WAF(Airlock)を独占販売しています。更に、企業向けのITセキュリティコ
ンサルティング業務を提供しています。特にカバーしているのはエンタープライスアーキテクチャに関するIT戦
略とセキュリティコンサルティング、情報セキュリティ並びにITリスクです。ご興味のある方は是非お問い合わ
せください。

Airlock
WAFはインターネット・バンキング、Eコマース、モバイル通信等、様々な業界で高く評価されています。現在、
スイスで実証されているインターネットバンキング用セキュリティのベンチマークと言っても過言ではありませ
ん。Airlock
WAFは日本の企業の重要なウェブアプリケーション並びにそのデータを保護し、高度なセキュリティレベルをも
たらします。

## Enterprise NOC Solutions

[Enterprise NOC Solutions]

ExterNetworks proudly serves SMEs and large enterprises across North America with mission-critical
24/7 Network Operations Center services. Our enterprise-grade NOC infrastructure supports complex,
multi-site environments with guaranteed 99.99% uptime SLAs and sub-15-minute incident response
times.

We manage networks spanning 10,000+ endpoints for global corporations, providing ITIL-compliant
processes, SOX/HIPAA/PCI DSS compliance support, and seamless integration with hybrid cloud and
on-premises infrastructure. Our dedicated client success team ensures customized runbooks,
executive-level reporting, and 24/7/365 escalation procedures tailored for SMEs and large-scale
enterprise operations.

###### Global Scale & Enterprise Capabilities

With over 15 years of enterprise IT operations experience, ExterNetworks operates state-of-the-art
NOCs across multiple time zones, ensuring continuous coverage for clients worldwide. Our enterprise
platform monitors over 50,000 network devices daily, processes 100,000+ events per hour, and
maintains a 99.5% first-call resolution rate.

We provide dedicated account management for enterprise clients, with certified ITIL experts and
industry-specific compliance specialists. Our enterprise-grade infrastructure includes redundant
monitoring systems, automated ticketing integration, and real-time analytics dashboards designed for
C-level visibility and reporting.

## Industries We Serve

We are privileged to have distinguished enterprise clients across a range of industries,
providing mission-critical NOC services that meet the most demanding operational requirements.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

## Where security meets what’s next

The world is changing fast. AI is reshaping how organizations operate, innovate, and connect – and
redefining what effective cybersecurity looks like on a global scale.

With longstanding deep security expertise and clear market leadership, Trend Micro leads across that
shift – from securing critical assets to advancing mobility and protecting modern digital life –
**at every layer of the digital ecosystem**.

Setting the standard in cybersecurity for **25,000 enterprise organizations across 185 countries**,
today Trend Micro operates as the publicly listed parent organization behind a focused portfolio of
cybersecurity businesses, each serving distinct customers, markets, and needs.

# AcrosecのWebサイトへようこそ

予防的かつ積極的なITセキュリテが気になりますでしょうか？我々にとっても大事なアプローチです。よく見ら
れる”後からの思い付き”によるITセキュリティをリリース後のソリューションを応急処置的にボルトオンするの
は、特にアプリケーション開発において、良い選択肢ではないと考えております。ICT製品の品質とそのITセキ
ュリティは関連し合い、一枚のコインの表と裏です。

アクロセック社は企業向けのITセキュリティソリューションを提供する日本法人です。取扱製品としてはスイス
のパートナーErgon社のハイエンド型WAF(Airlock)を独占販売しています。更に、企業向けのITセキュリティコ
ンサルティング業務を提供しています。特にカバーしているのはエンタープライスアーキテクチャに関するIT戦
略とセキュリティコンサルティング、情報セキュリティ並びにITリスクです。ご興味のある方は是非お問い合わ
せください。

Airlock
WAFはインターネット・バンキング、Eコマース、モバイル通信等、様々な業界で高く評価されています。現在、
スイスで実証されているインターネットバンキング用セキュリティのベンチマークと言っても過言ではありませ
ん。Airlock
WAFは日本の企業の重要なウェブアプリケーション並びにそのデータを保護し、高度なセキュリティレベルをも
たらします。

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

# Securing the World’s Critical Resources

50+ years designing, integrating, and sustaining mission-critical security for the DoD, federal
agencies, and critical infrastructure worldwide.

[ Expore Our Solutions ][46]

**THE ADVANTOR ADVANTAGE**

## Design • Integrate • Sustain

A single, accountable partner across the full security program lifecycle — from first requirement to
decades of sustainment

### Design

Expert consultation and tailored designs align your infrastructure, risks, and compliance from the
start.

### Fulfillment

Reliable fulfillment combines proprietary products, trusted equipment partners, and coordinated
logistics.

### Installation

Expert installation delivers office-configured systems through certified professionals, ready for
deployment.

### Testing

Rigorous testing and quality control verify every system through walkthroughs and follow-up
inspections.

### Training

Flexible training builds confident teams through standard, certified, customized, and refresher
programs.

### Sustainment

Proactive service and sustainment keep systems ready with maintenance, support, warranties,
modernization.

### 1. Design

Requirements development, threat and vulnerability assessment, and full system engineering. We
architect integrated security solutions to exacting federal standards before a single cable is
pulled.

### 2. Integrate

Installation, testing, and commissioning executed by cleared teams — unifying IDS, access control,
video management, and command & control into one platform with minimal disruption to live
operations.

### 3. Sustain

Preventive maintenance, 24/7 support, modernization, and lifecycle logistics. As both manufacturer
and integrator, we sustain systems for decades — protecting your investment and readiness.

**Services**

## One integrated platform for the world's highest-security environments

Advantor is both a security technology manufacturer and a global systems integrator. We unify
Intrusion Detection (IDS), Access Control (ACS), Video Surveillance (VMS/VSS/CCTV), and Command &
Control (C2) into a single cohesive platform — eliminating the seams where risk lives.

Our roots run deep in the Department of Defense, yet our proven approach protects critical
infrastructure across energy, aerospace, transportation, and the commercial enterprise.
* Manufacturer & integrator in one
* DoD-grade compliance & standards
* Cleared, expert installation teams
* Decades of lifecycle sustainment

[ Our Solutions ][47]

## Protection engineered for readiness and value

By unifying cutting-edge technologies into a single platform, the Advantor Suite for Networks (ASN)
delivers robust protection and streamlined management for complete asset security.

### Access & Support

The full spectrum of security technology — hardware design, software development, manufacturing,
integration, training, and logistics

### Design & Distribution

Optimized system design and direct distribution eliminate the middle-man, integrating cleanly with
existing infrastructure.

### Adapt in Real Time

As both manufacturer and integrator, Advantor adapts in real time — saving money and time while
reducing customer impact.

  Automotive Heat Shields for Thermal Protection and Heat Management Category Overview Automotive
  heat shields are essential components designed to manage heat exposure within vehicle systems and
  protect surrounding components from excessive temperatures. As modern vehicles generate higher
  thermal loads due to compact engine designs and stricter emissions requirements, effective heat
  shielding has become a critical part of automotive thermal management. This category includes a
  range of automotive heat shield solutions engineered to reduce radiant and convective heat,
  improve system reliability, and enhance vehicle safety across diverse automotive applications.
  Applications in Automotive Systems Automotive heat shields are widely used in areas exposed to
  high temperatures, including: Exhaust systems and exhaust manifolds Turbochargers and downpipes
  Engine compartments and underbody protection Fuel lines, brake lines, and wiring harnesses
  Electric vehicle and hybrid vehicle thermal management By limiting heat transfer, automotive heat

  protect surrounding components from excessive temperatures. As modern vehicles generate higher

  shielding has become a critical part of automotive thermal management. This category includes a

  improve system reliability, and enhance vehicle safety across diverse automotive applications.

  high temperatures, including: Exhaust systems and exhaust manifolds Turbochargers and downpipes
  Engine compartments and underbody protection Fuel lines, brake lines, and wiring harnesses

  shields help prevent heat-related component degradation and improve overall vehicle performance.
  Materials and Heat Shield Technologies Automotive heat shields are manufactured using advanced
  high-temperature materials selected for durability, flexibility, and thermal efficiency. Common
  heat shield constructions include: Aluminized barriers for radiant heat reflection
  High-temperature insulation layers for thermal resistance Flexible heat shield materials for
  complex geometries Lightweight designs to support fuel efficiency and performance Material
  selection depends on temperature exposure, installation space, and vehicle system requirements.
  Benefits of Automotive Heat Shields Properly designed automotive heat shields provide multiple
  performance and safety benefits: Reduction of radiant and convective heat transfer Protection of

  Enhanced safety in high-temperature operating conditions Support for compliance with automotive

# BunkerWeb, the open-source and next generation web application firewall (WAF)

## Make your web services secure by default

Fool attackers and protect your web services with our open-source Web Application Firewall.
BunkerWeb acting as a shield in front of your web services, it blocks attacks before they can hit
and guarantees condidentiality, integrity and availability of your data.

[ Read the doc ][27]
[ 1min Video ][28]

## Web security without any hassle

Placed as a reverse proxy while offering Web Application Firewall (WAF) functionalities, the
BunkerWeb solution integrates seamlessly into your existing infrastructure to secure your web
services.

BunkerWeb will help you defend against common web threats such as those listed in the OWASP Top 10,
block malicious bots, mitigate DDoS attacks and much more…

Use the solution as a single entry point for your web services and easily manage your HTTPS
certificates, incoming traffic from external sources, and security policies related to the HTTP
protocol. In other words, the security of your websites, applications and APIs is no longer a
hassle.
* Seamless integration into your existing infrastructure
* Reverse proxy with built-in security features
* Open-source solution auditable by a third party
* Fully configurable to meet your needs

### Integrations

More info on how to install BunkerWeb on Linux, Docker and Kubernetes in [our documentation][29]

[ Github repository ][30]
[ Join our discord ][31]

### AGPLv3 free license

## An open-source solution

Distributed under the AGPLv3 free license, the solution’s core code is entirely auditable by a third
party and the community. Unlike the opaque “black boxes” available on the market, we’ve made the
choice of transparency and peer validation. In other words, we advocate for open security over
security through obscurity. Do not choose the shadows anymore, discover the light.

Why Choose Open Source?
* **Total Transparency:** accessible source code ensures maximum trust and security
* **Active Community:** benefit from global collaboration with users worldwide
* **Sovereignty:** keep control and ownership of your data
* **Customization:** tailor the software to meet your project’s specific needs

Do not choose the shadows anymore, discover the light.

[ Github repository ][32]
[ Plugins list ][33]
Our Vision

### Transparency

BunkerWeb places transparency at the core of its solution, allowing users access to clear, open
code. This approach ensures uncompromised security and offers full visibility into every protective
mechanism in place.
Our mission

### Auditability

BunkerWeb’s auditability enables users to verify and assess the security measures applied. By
providing open access to code and configurations, BunkerWeb facilitates regular audits, enhancing
compliance and trust.

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

# OWASP Coraza WAF

Open source Web Application Firewall for APIs and web applications. Enterprise-grade protection,
100% compatible with OWASP Core Rule Set.

[Get Started][12] [Learn More][13]

## Built for Modern APIs

High-performance protection for REST, GraphQL, and gRPC endpoints. Coraza handles massive throughput
with minimal latency impact.

### Enterprise Ready

Hardened for mission-critical infrastructure and high-availability environments.

### Legacy Systems

Drop-in replacement for ModSecurity, supporting existing rule sets and workflows.

### Universal Deployment

Run as a sidecar, proxy, or library in Go, C++, and WebAssembly.

## Why Security Teams Choose Coraza

Engineered for the modern security landscape.

### Security First

Rigorous testing and full OWASP CRS compatibility ensure your applications are protected against top
threats from day one.

### High Performance

Written in Go with an optimized engine, Coraza delivers microsecond-level inspection even at peak
traffic loads.

### Extensible

A modular plugin architecture allows you to create custom rules, operators, and logging backends
tailored to your needs.

## Deploy Anywhere

Coraza isn't just a standalone service. Integrate it directly into your infrastructure using our
versatile connectors and SDKs.

### The Reuters Ethics Scandals: Photo Manipulation, Financial Misinformation, and the Cost of Speed

For over 150 years, Reuters has been a pillar of global journalism. However, in the digital age, the
pressure for "real-time" speed has led to several catastrophic forensic failures. From the blatant
2006 manipulation of war photos by freelancer Adnan Hajj to misleading financial headlines that
wiped out billions in market value, this report dissects the forensic breakdown of editorial
oversight and the ethical compromises of modern media giants.

][6][
The VaultJul 18, 2026

### Repsol: The $10B YPF Nationalization and the $16B Burford Legal Disaster

In 2012, the Argentine government seized a 51% stake in YPF from the Spanish giant Repsol. Forensic
discovery unmasked that the move was triggered by the discovery of the massive Vaca Muerta shale
reserves. While Argentina paid $5 Billion in bonds to settle with Repsol in 2014, a 2023-2024 U.S.
court ruling has ordered Argentina to pay an additional $16 Billion to minority shareholders,
unmasking the nationalization as a terminal financial catastrophe. This report dissects the Eskenazi
family circular financing, the Burford Capital litigation, and the 2024 Milei pivot.

][7][
The VaultJul 18, 2026

### Renault: The 'French State' Emissions Scandal and the $3.5B Diesel Deception

In 2024, Renault remains under intense judicial scrutiny in Paris for a decade-long emissions fraud
that allegedly deceived millions of consumers. Forensic discovery unmasked a "Thermal Window"
loophole where emissions controls were deactivated outside of a narrow 17°C-35°C range. This report
dissects the DGCCRF fraud report implicating Carlos Ghosn, the systemic failure of the LNT (Lean NOx
Trap) technology, and the terminal conflict of interest of the French state as both shareholder and
regulator.

][8][
The VaultJul 18, 2026

In 2005, Refco, one of the world's largest commodities brokers, collapsed just 60 days after its
massive IPO. Forensic discovery unmasked that CEO Phillip Bennett had hidden $430 Million in bad
debts within a personal shell company (RGHI) using fraudulent bridge loans from the Austrian bank
BAWAG. This report dissects the Thomas H. Lee Partners due diligence failure, the "Round-Tripping"
cash scheme, and the 2024 status of the firm’s assets under Interactive Brokers.

The VaultJul 17, 2026

In October 2024, the defense giant RTX (formerly Raytheon) agreed to pay over $950 Million to the
U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) to resolve three major scandals: a massive overcharging scheme for
Patriot missiles, a decade-long bribery operation in Qatar, and a failure to disclose accurate
pricing data to the Pentagon. This report dissects the forensic reality of the "Defective Pricing"
fraud, the use of shell companies to launder bribes, and the systemic failure of oversight in the
$800 billion U.S. defense budget.

CSSI

A leader in engineered asset protection using composite material technology.

# Advanced Fire, Ballistic & Impact Protection SolutionsEngineered Ceramic Composite Panels Designed
# to Protect Critical Assets

CSSI delivers engineered protection solutions backed by proven research and unmatched material
performance. We combine proven technical expertise with advanced ceramic composites that offer
exceptional [fire][13] and [ballistic resistance][14], structural integrity, and long-term
durability, even in the most demanding environments.

[Our clients][15] include architectural and engineering firms, utility contractors, public and
private utilities, defense contractors, data management companies, and government agencies. We work
closely with our customers to develop tailored composite solutions to protect their critical,
sensitive, and valuable assets.

## Why Choose CSSI?

### Customizable Sizes and Designs
* Modular lightweight panels (320 lb.) for easy handling and installation.
* A standard wall (35 feet L x 30 feet H) can be installed in one day.
* Short manufacturing time, 4–6 weeks, and 3–4 months for large orders.
* Permanent or deployable wall systems available.
* Designed and manufactured in the USA.

### Reduction in Time, Labor and Costs
* Material costs are typically in line with precast concrete options.
* Panels are installed quickly, saving time and reducing labor costs.
* Freight and shipping costs are lower than those for concrete wall systems.

### Environmental Responsible Panels
* Panels are manufactured using sustainable technology.
* Manufacturing and shipping related CO₂ emissions are reduced when compared to concrete wall
  systems.

## Ceramic Composite Panel Benefits
* Firewall panels are formed to include air pockets for superior thermal insulation and fire
  resistance.
* Internal air pockets of ballistic panels are filled with sand or pea gravel to absorb and
  dissipate energy from gunshots and ballistic projectiles.
* Steel columns, casings, and nuts are protected using composite materials.
* Designed to minimize load-bearing impact at the base of the wall.
* Panels exceed government and private industry tests for strength and impact.
* No maintenance needed.
* Earthquake proof.
* Walls can be installed in extreme cold climates and withstand severe weather and harsh
  environmental conditions.

## Protecting Critical Infrastructure from the Ground Up

Let’s get started on a composite wall solution for you today.

# EVORIM Excellent software

###### We develop software. Successfully.

###### Our software protects you, your privacy and your data.

###### Use our software and be amazed.

## Advanced Backup

Reliable and fast data backup

Advanced Backup is backup software that lets you professionally back up your important files and
drives. The program offers a variety of functions and settings. Scheduled or manual backups to all
common media with optional compression and encryption of your data.

[ Advanced Backup ][11]

## Free Firewall

Identify threats.
Protect privacy.

Free firewall is a full-featured professional firewall that protects against the threats of the
Internet. Control every program on your computer by permit or deny access to the Internet. Free
firewall notifies you when applications want to access the Internet in the background without your
knowledge.

[ Free Firewall ][12]

## HotkeyPro

Work faster. Increase productivity.

With HotkeyPro, you create hotkeys and keywords that allow you to automate various workflows and
actions. At the push of a button you can start programs, open folders or cathedral documents of any
kind, insert your own texts, simulate keystrokes and process scripts with which the range of
functions can be extended many times over..

[ HotkeyPro ][13]

## Cloudevo

Connect all your cloud storage together.

The software Cloudevo aggregates any number of cloud storage to a big united cloud. Cloudevo
combines all of the different cloud services to one large cloud. This united Cloud is then mounted
as a drive on your device. All files are encrypted securely on the Cloud drive.

[ Cloudevo ][14]

## Security breaks when firewall policy breaks.

Enterprises don’t lack cybersecurity tools. They lack control.

Policies are scattered across firewalls, clouds, and segmentation tools, creating blind spots,
drift, and compliance gaps that attackers exploit.

#### FireMon brings it back together.

## How we stop policy from undermining security:

[Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud][Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud]

### Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud

FireMon serves as the system of record for network security policy. It normalizes and governs
firewall rules across on-prem and cloud environments, giving teams a single place to manage policy
for safer and controlled change.

readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

### Frequently Asked Questions

What are industrial switches, and how do they differ from regular switches?

Industrial switches are specialized networking devices designed for harsh environments. They offer
higher durability, extended temperature ranges, and advanced features like redundancy and enhanced
security compared to standard switches. This makes them suitable for applications in manufacturing,
transportation, and other industrial settings.

What types of industrial switches does SanSo Network offer?

SanSo Network provides a range of industrial switches, including unmanaged, managed, and PoE (Power
over Ethernet) switches. Our product lineup caters to various networking needs, from basic
connectivity to advanced network management features.

Are SanSo industrial switches compatible with other networking equipment?

Yes, our industrial switches are designed to be compatible with a wide range of networking equipment
and protocols. They support standard Ethernet and can integrate seamlessly with other devices in
your network infrastructure.

Prevention-First Cybersecurity

# Know More.
# Miss Less.

Intrusion is a prevention-first cybersecurity company. Most security stacks detect threats after
they're inside and alert you once the damage is underway. We take a different position: we see every
connection moving in and out of your network and block bad traffic before it becomes a breach.

Here you'll find the Shield platform, the Global Threat Engine that powers it, and the
prevention-first approach behind both.

[See How Shield Works][31] [Run a Proof of Value][32]

## WHAT YOU CAN'T SEE *WILL HURT YOU.*

When was the last time your stack showed you everything leaving your network?

Packet sampling. Encrypted traffic. Outbound blind spots. Misconfigured firewalls. Unmanaged devices
nobody bothered to patch.

Every gap is a door. Every door is a way in, and a way back out for exfiltration. Most security
stacks accept this as the cost of doing business.

**Shield doesn't.**

It sees every connection, then blocks the ones that shouldn't be there. Both directions. No
sampling. No baselining. No exceptions.

## No Learning Curve. No Grace Period. No Waiting.

Shield protects from the second it's deployed. No 30-day baseline. No tuning window. No "let's see
what normal looks like." The [Global Threat Engine][33] has been building IP and DNS reputation
since 2001. 8.5 billion combinations today. Shield checks every connection against it and drops the
malicious ones autonomously, in-line, both directions.

[See How Shield Works][34]

[Shield blocking ransomware connection]

## Three Things Detection-Only Platforms Can't Say.

Most security stacks watch and wait. Shield blocks. That difference shows up three ways.

### We Don't Detect. We Block.

Detection tells you something bad already happened. Shield stops the connection before the threat
lands. No alerts. No incident response. No "lessons learned" memo.

### Built By Us. Since 2001.

The Global Threat Engine isn't a licensed feed or a community share. 8.5 billion IP and DNS
combinations. Built by Intrusion, owned by Intrusion, sharper than anything you can subscribe to.

### Inbound. Outbound. In-Line.

Most platforms watch one direction and hope. Shield enforces both. Drops into your existing
architecture in minutes. No agent on every device. No backhaul. No drama.

Prevention-First Cybersecurity

# Know More.
# Miss Less.

Intrusion is a prevention-first cybersecurity company. Most security stacks detect threats after
they're inside and alert you once the damage is underway. We take a different position: we see every
connection moving in and out of your network and block bad traffic before it becomes a breach.

Here you'll find the Shield platform, the Global Threat Engine that powers it, and the
prevention-first approach behind both.

[See How Shield Works][31] [Run a Proof of Value][32]

## WHAT YOU CAN'T SEE *WILL HURT YOU.*

When was the last time your stack showed you everything leaving your network?

Packet sampling. Encrypted traffic. Outbound blind spots. Misconfigured firewalls. Unmanaged devices
nobody bothered to patch.

Every gap is a door. Every door is a way in, and a way back out for exfiltration. Most security
stacks accept this as the cost of doing business.

**Shield doesn't.**

It sees every connection, then blocks the ones that shouldn't be there. Both directions. No
sampling. No baselining. No exceptions.

## No Learning Curve. No Grace Period. No Waiting.

Shield protects from the second it's deployed. No 30-day baseline. No tuning window. No "let's see
what normal looks like." The [Global Threat Engine][33] has been building IP and DNS reputation
since 2001. 8.5 billion combinations today. Shield checks every connection against it and drops the
malicious ones autonomously, in-line, both directions.

[See How Shield Works][34]

[Shield blocking ransomware connection]

## Three Things Detection-Only Platforms Can't Say.

Most security stacks watch and wait. Shield blocks. That difference shows up three ways.

### We Don't Detect. We Block.

Detection tells you something bad already happened. Shield stops the connection before the threat
lands. No alerts. No incident response. No "lessons learned" memo.

### Built By Us. Since 2001.

The Global Threat Engine isn't a licensed feed or a community share. 8.5 billion IP and DNS
combinations. Built by Intrusion, owned by Intrusion, sharper than anything you can subscribe to.

### Inbound. Outbound. In-Line.

Most platforms watch one direction and hope. Shield enforces both. Drops into your existing
architecture in minutes. No agent on every device. No backhaul. No drama.

residential integrators to effectively monitor and fully manage their customers' networks,
significantly reducing on-site visits. With Keenetic RMM, you can save valuable resources and

## Monitoring and alerts

Stay informed and receive timely notifications of critical site events with real-time alerts

## Team management

monitoring and management system. Each team member can have their own individual login, enabling
scalability and reducing risk by implementing two-factor authentication (2FA) or single sign-on
(SSO). You also have the flexibility to invite members from different organizations to collaborate
on specific sites. Track team member usage with comprehensive logging for efficient auditing.

For even greater organization, take advantage of our powerful Custom Labels feature. This allows you
to create groups of sites or nodes to streamline your monitoring process. By selecting specific
labels, you can easily view and manage the sites or nodes that are most relevant to your needs.

# OWASP
# Modsecurity Project

[Rules protecting a safe]

## Open Source Web Application Firewall

[ModSecurity][14] is an open source, cross-platform web application firewall (WAF) module. Known as
the “Swiss Army Knife” of WAFs, it enables web application defenders to gain visibility into HTTP(S)
traffic and provides a power rules language and API to implement advanced protections.

[Get latest v2: 2.9.12][15] [Get latest v3: 3.0.14][16]

## The most widespread open source WAF

Used by businesses, government organizations, internet service providers, and commercial WAF vendors
alike on millions of domains all over the world. The engine, coupled with OWASP CRS - the dominant
WAF rule set, undeniably raises the level of protection against HTTP attacks to a higher level.

[Become a part of it!][17]

## ModSecurity under OWASP's custodianship

OWASP® Foundation, the leading open community dedicated to application security, is already
responsible for the Core Rule Set, the dominant WAF rule set on the market. By joining the
ModSecurity WAF to their repertoire, OWASP can now steer ModSecurity’s development with a holistic
view, fostering even tighter integration between the core rule set and the underlying framework.
[Rules protecting a safe]

### Getting Started

## Usage scenarios
* Real-time application security monitoring and access control
* Full HTTP traffic logging
* Continuous passive security assessment
* Web application hardening

[Download][18]

## Principles
* Flexibility
* Passiveness
* Predictability
* Quality over quantity

[Getting Started][19]

## Community

Since 1978, MSEDP has offered tech support and computer consulting services to businesses on Long
Island, in the New York City metropolitan area, and across the United States. Our IT support team
has one goal: To keep your computer systems up and running at peak efficiency. Get trusted
cybersecurity services, computer tech support, remote monitoring, antivirus and spam protection,
cloud backup, disaster recovery, Office 365, email solutions and more from your Long Island MSP. Our
expert IT service team will help prevent data loss and data breaches, provide remote tech support,
help with spam protection, and work with you regarding any IT service you need to keep your small
business running smoothly.

][87]

website to stand out these days. At MSEDP, we design websites that are perfect for small businesses.

fully responsive, so your website will look perfect on desktops, laptops, and mobile devices. We
offer our own proprietary V5 Content Management System as well as the very popular WordPress CMS
with over 55,000 plug-ins (like WooCommerce) available to ensure you get the most out of your
website. All our websites developed are, by default, search-engine-optimized, which means your
customers will be able to find you on the web!

## Enterprise Security Features Built In

Every [Netgate appliance][29] ships with pfSense® — the world's most trusted open-source firewall
platform.

#### Stateful Firewall

Deep packet inspection with stateful connection tracking. Block threats before they reach your
network perimeter.

#### VPN Gateway

IPsec, OpenVPN and WireGuard® support. Secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN for your workforce.

#### IDS / IPS

Snort and Suricata integration for real-time intrusion detection and prevention with auto-blocking
rules.

#### Content Filtering

Web content filtering with pfBlockerNG — block ads, trackers, malicious domains and inappropriate
content.

#### Traffic Shaping / QoS

HFSC and PRIQ traffic shaping. Prioritise voice, video and critical business applications
automatically.

#### Multi-WAN & Failover

Load balance across multiple ISP links and automatic failover — ensuring zero downtime for your
business.

#### VLAN Segmentation

Isolate networks with 802.1Q VLAN support. Separate IoT, guest, employee and PCI DSS zones
effortlessly.

#### Monitoring & Reporting

Real-time dashboards, bandwidth graphs, traffic analysis and syslog export to your SIEM platform.

#### High Availability

CARP-based HA clustering with automatic state sync. Deploy active-passive pairs for mission-critical
uptime.

Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) is a term coined by Gartner that combines security and network
functions into a unified cloud-based service, simplifying the management of complex networks while
providing protection against a wide range of cyber threats. SASE is particularly relevant for
organizations that are moving toward cloud-based applications as a service, and that have a
distributed workforce or branch offices. It offers a more agile and secure approach to network and
security management.

native, managed SASE offering that ensures high availability, secure access with agility,
resilience, and security to maximize IT investments and free teams to focus on driving business
success.

Welcome to the official OSSEC website. Here you can find free [OSSEC open-source host-based
intrusion detection system (HIDS) downloads][43] and [community support][44]. Atomicorp manages the
OSSEC project and actively develops OSSEC. See **[OSSEC Development Timeline][45]. **The
foundational OSSEC HIDS provides multi–platform log-based intrusion detection, [file integrity
monitoring (FIM)][46], malware detection, active response, compliance auditing, and more.

## OSSEC FAQs

 

### Where can I download OSSEC?

You can download the official version of OSSEC directly from the [OSSEC downloads page][48]. Our
site is the trusted authority for OSSEC, and we provide both the free source code and ready-to-use
binaries so you don’t have to compile it yourself.

### Is OSSEC free to use?

Yes. OSSEC is a free, open-source host-based intrusion detection system (HIDS). It has been trusted
by security teams worldwide for decades, and you can use it at no cost. Learn more or download the
[rules][49].

### What is the difference between OSSEC and Atomic OSSEC?

OSSEC is the free, open-source version. Atomic OSSEC is a commercial-grade enhancement of OSSEC that
includes enterprise features including centralized endpoint firewall management, vulnerability
management, compliance scanning, SIEM, EDR, antivirus, advanced HIDS, real-time file integrity
monitoring (FIM) and the reduction of false positives and false negatives through machine learning
(ML). Atomic OSSEC also provides a graphical interface (GUI), advanced reporting, and professional
support. [Explore Atomic OSSEC][50].

### What is OSSEC+?

OSSEC+ is the enhanced version of OSSEC that includes additional features such as threat
intelligence and hundreds of more rules than basic OSSEC. By registering for OSSEC+ on the [OSSEC
downloads page][51], you gain access to OSSEC+ at no cost, giving you more capabilities than the
standard open-source release.

### Does Atomic OSSEC include OSSEC+?

Yes. Atomic OSSEC includes OSSEC+ and more, including hundreds of additional out-of-the-box rules,
machine learning, AV, endpoint firewall management, vulnerability management, compliance scanning,
built-in software integrations, a GUI, reporting tools and more, making Atomic OSSEC the most
advanced version of OSSEC.

### What is the most advanced version of OSSEC?

Atomic OSSEC is the most advanced version of OSSEC. Atomic OSSEC contains 10X the security and
compliance rules of free OSSEC, plus real-time file integrity monitoring (FIM) and malware
detection, endpoint firewall management, antivirus, extended vulnerability detection and
remediation, machine learning and automated response, full SIEM, dashboard GUI and more. [Visit the
webpage][52] or [get a demo][53].

pre-compiled binaries for popular platforms. You can find them on the [OSSEC downloads page][54].
Atomicorp.com also provides commercially supported pre-compiled binaries for a wide range of
platforms including signed Microsoft and macOS binaries and for end of life and legacy systems
including Solaris, AIX, older versions of Linux and more.

I don't hand over a report and leave. I work alongside your team through the full arc — from
understanding what you actually run, to operating it safely.

01 / Assess

### Assess

Discovery of your current network, firewall policy base and exposure. A risk baseline grounded in
what's really deployed — not assumptions.

02 / Architect

### Architect

A target design and phased roadmap with a clear business case. Topology, segmentation, HA and the
order to get there without downtime.

### Deploy

Hands-on implementation with change windows, rollback plans and production safety. I configure,

Eight focused practices. Each engagement is scoped to your environment — below is the depth you can
expect across scope, deliverables and the stack I work in.

### Network Architecture & Design

Design the network so security is structural, not bolted on.

#### Scope
* Campus, datacentre and multi-site WAN topology design
* Routing & switching architecture, VLAN and segmentation strategy
* High availability: active-active firewall clusters, VRRP, redundant uplinks
* Capacity and growth modelling for AI / high-density workloads

#### What you get
* Reference architecture, topology diagrams and IP/VLAN plan
* HA failover design, bill of materials and phased migration runbook

* Rollout sequencing that won't break production traffic

* Zero-trust policy model and identity/posture integration design
* Segmentation map and a staged, reversible cutover plan

# Private Proxy Guide – VPN, Proxy & Online Privacy Guides


# Private Proxy Guide

Private Proxy Guide provides independent guides and reviews focused on VPN services, proxy
solutions, and online privacy tools.

Our goal is to explain how VPNs and proxy services work in real-world scenarios, how to use them on
different devices and apps, and how to choose the right solution based on security, performance, and
access needs.

All guides are written with a practical focus, combining technical explanations with step-by-step
instructions to help you understand and use privacy tools more effectively.

VPN & device setups
Proxy & scraping use cases
Privacy & security fundamentals
Hands-on testing
Clear, practical guidance

**Editorial approach:** clarity, transparency, and usability rather than generic rankings or
marketing claims.

## On Private Proxy Guide, you’ll find

VPN guides for devices, apps, streaming services, and online platforms

Explanations of VPN protocols, encryption, and security features

Proxy guides covering residential, datacenter, and scraping use cases

Practical tutorials showing how to set up and use privacy tools correctly

We focus on **clarity**, **transparency**, and **usability** rather than generic rankings or
marketing claims.

## How we cover VPNs & privacy

Our VPN and privacy content covers a wide range of use cases, including mobile devices, desktop
systems, routers, gaming platforms, and popular online services.

Instead of focusing only on “best” lists, we explain why certain features matter, how performance is
affected in different situations, and what to consider before choosing a VPN or proxy service.

### Proxy technology guides

In addition to VPNs, we publish detailed guides about proxy technologies and network privacy. These
articles explain how different proxy types work, when they are useful, and how they compare to VPN
solutions for tasks such as automation, scraping, and traffic routing.

### Independent methodology

Our guides are created independently and are based on hands-on testing, technical analysis, and
real-world usage scenarios. We aim to provide balanced information that helps readers understand
both the advantages and limitations of different tools, without relying on exaggerated claims or
unnecessary complexity.

## Who this site is for

Private Proxy Guide is designed to help users navigate online privacy with confidence, whether they
are beginners or more advanced users.

Jump-start that Car or Truck project in the garage with one of QuietRide’s year-make-model specific
automotive products that are pre-cut, and ready-to-install. A logo branded AcoustiHood Cover will
protect your hood and complete the engine bay. A Firewall Insulator will block your engine’s heat
from entering the passenger cabin. Our AcoustiShield Thermal Acoustic Insulation Kits will make the
passenger cabin “Cool and Quiet Inside!” And finally, your car trunk compartment makes more noise
than you think and you can top it off with a AcoustiTrunk Floor Mat and Insulation Kit. For truck
owners, we have molded headliners and rear cab covers and coming soon will be our logo branded
AcoustiTruck Bed Floor Cover for classic trucks.



AcoustiShield Thermal Acoustic Insulation Kits will reduce passenger cabin noise, vibration and heat
and give you the same “Quiet Riding Comfort” you get from your luxury daily driver. Our two-stage
acoustic products cover the entire interior of your car from the toe-boards to the
taillights—Cowl—Floor—Roof—Doors—Trunk Floor and Body Panels (rear wheel wells, fenders, package
tray and seat divider). We use AcoustiShield Damper Pads to stop body panel vibration and HeatShield
to trap the sound and insulate the interior, reducing passenger cabin noise by 50 percent and
cutting radiant and reflective heat by 25 degrees. Each kit is year-make-model specific—pre-cut and
ready to install.

[ More Info][29] [ Catalogs][30] [ Order Online][31]


The Firewall Insulator is your first defense against engine noise and heat. Your old factory
firewall insulator was made with tarpaper or rubber and by now is turning to dust and falling apart.
QuietRide molds each firewall to fit the engine/transmission setbacks to fit like a glove with our
unique vacuum forming process. We use either an ABS Material or a High Definition Rubber mat
material depending on the Year, Make, and Model of your vehicle. Each firewall is then digitally cut
and stock holes are punch to OEM specification. We have more than 600 firewalls are available for
antique, classic, custom and street rod cars and trucks. Each firewall insulator is year, make and
model specific and comes with the insulation attached—ready to install. And yes, you can get them
without holes for street rod and custom projects. Firewalls are listed in each of our catalogs.


[ More Info][32] [ Catalogs][33] [ Order Online][34]


AcoustiHood Under Hood Cover and Insulation Kits provide an insulating barrier to protect the
exterior hood paint and cover up the the mishmash of structural ribs and pockets and dings and dents
typically found on the under side hood panels. Smooth Under Hood Covers are available for vehicle
restorations. 3-D molded Under Hood Covers feature vehicle brand names and logos molded in raised
letters and graphics. Under Hood Cover kits are year, make and model specific—pre-cut and ready to
install with mounting hardware.




[ More Info][35] [ Catalogs][36] [ Order Online][37]


Most cars have little or no insulation in the rear area of the vehicle which allows the noise,
vibration and heat (NVH) from the trunk floor pan to enter the passenger cabin. Now you can stop the
transfer of NVH and dress up the trunk area with one of Quiet Ride’s new AcoustiTrunk Floor Mat and
Insulation Kits. Smooth Trunk Mat Covers are available for vehicle restorations. 3-D molded Trunk
Mat Covers feature vehicle brand names and logos molded into the Ultra High Definition rubber floor
mat material with raised letters and graphics. Trunk mat cover and insulation cover kits are
year-make-model specific—pre-cut and ready to install.

What is Snort?

Snort is the foremost Open Source Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) in the world. Snort IPS uses a
series of rules that help define malicious network activity and uses those rules to find packets
that match against them and generates alerts for users.

Snort can be deployed inline to stop these packets, as well. Snort has three primary uses: As a
packet sniffer like tcpdump, as a packet logger — which is useful for network traffic debugging, or
it can be used as a full-blown network intrusion prevention system. Snort can be downloaded and
configured for personal and business use alike.

What are my options for buying and using Snort?

Once downloaded and configured, Snort rules are distributed in two sets: The “Community Ruleset” and
the “Snort Subscriber Ruleset.”

The Snort Subscriber Ruleset is developed, tested, and approved by Cisco Talos. Subscribers to the
Snort Subscriber Ruleset will receive the ruleset in real time as they are released to Cisco
customers. You can download the rules and deploy them in your network through the Snort.org website.
The Community Ruleset is developed by the Snort community and QAed by Cisco Talos. It is freely
available to all users.

For more information about Snort Subscriber Rulesets available for purchase, please visit the [Snort
product page][35].

[Get Started][36]
Step 1

#### Download and install the source code

If this is your first time installing Snort, please review the [dependencies list][37].

[https://github.com/snort3/snort3/releases][38]

You can also get the code with:

git clone https://github.com/snort3/snort3.git

There are separate extras packages for cmake that provide additional features and demonstrate how to
build plugins. The source for extras is in the [snort3_extra.git][39] repo.

Step 2

#### Sign up and get your Oinkcode - a unique identifier that must be entered into your Snort
#### instance that will automatically pull in Snort rules. All users have access to the Registered
#### Rule Set. In order to get the latest detections (Subscriber Rule Set) you can upgrade your
#### subscription at any time.

[Sign up/Subscribe][40]
Step 3

#### For video instructions and additional documents, check out our [resources][41] page.

#### You can also read the [Snort 3 instruction manual][42].

packet logging.

## Is Your Security System Enough?

## Is Your Security System Enough?

[two sonitrol workers reviewing space]

## A Better, Verified Solution

SONITROL has the quickest alarm verification, the fastest police response times, the lowest false
alarm rates, and the best apprehension rate, over 188,000 and counting, in the security industry.

## Innovative Technology

Our advanced, impact-activated audio detection trigger alerts faster than conventional alarms, and
help increase the chances of apprehension. Enhance your entire system by easily integrating audio
intrusion, video verification, fire monitoring and access control solutions to help cover your
entire business with greater accuracy.

[Keypad]
[Laptop on counter ]

## Comprehensive Coverage

Unlike most conventional alarms, which only provide limited detection, SONITROL security systems
offer wall-to-wall, floor-to-ceiling, volumetric coverage to meet sophisticated threats.

[Sonitrol technician installing a camera onto a cement block wall.]
[A woman pressing a code into a security system. ]

## State-of-the-Art Monitoring

SONITROL personnel monitor fewer alarms per operator (80% fewer than the national average) leading
to quicker response times. Our security systems include many specific alarm types, giving us the
ability to provide police with more complete, real-time information from the time of the alert
through the apprehension.

[monitoring 2]
[monitoring]

## Better Results

Our reputation for low false alarms and verified reporting leads to a quicker police response when a
SONITROL alarm comes in. In fact, police respond to SONITROL alarms 400% faster, and more than 20%
of our apprehensions occur before the criminal gains entry.

[Sonitrol technician loading up a van post install.]

## The Unified Control Plane for the Agentic Era

As agents initiate, validate, and execute more infrastructure change, decisions that affect network

visibility. They need a trusted way to understand what is actually reachable, validate policy
intent, and govern change across the enterprise.

## One Control Plane. Total Network Control.

Tufin manages fragmented tools with a unified control plane that delivers centralized visibility,
automated change control, and continuous compliance across your entire hybrid network.

like AWS, Azure, and GCP—unifying visibility and control across hybrid environments.

Continuously monitor firewalls, cloud, SASE, and microsegmentation environments to ensure alignment
and enforcement of security policies, preventing lateral movement paths before attackers can exploit
them.

][145]
[

### Simplifies and Optimizes Security Policy Management

Reduces policy complexity by analyzing and cleaning up redundant, risky, and outdated rules, while
automatically enforcing least-privilege access to strengthen your overall security posture.

### Maintains Continuous Compliance and Audit Readiness

internal standards and external frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOX, DORA, and NIST.

## A Control Plane for Your Entire Network Security Ecosystem

Tufin integrates seamlessly with the technologies powering your hybrid network—from firewalls to
cloud, SASE, microsegmentation, and beyond.

### Multi-Vendor Firewalls

Centralized visibility and unified policy enforcement across traditional and hybrid mesh
architectures, including Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, and more.

50+ years designing, integrating, and sustaining mission-critical security for the DoD, federal
agencies, and critical infrastructure worldwide.

**THE ADVANTOR ADVANTAGE**

## Design • Integrate • Sustain

A single, accountable partner across the full security program lifecycle — from first requirement to
decades of sustainment

### Design

Expert consultation and tailored designs align your infrastructure, risks, and compliance from the
start.

### Fulfillment

Reliable fulfillment combines proprietary products, trusted equipment partners, and coordinated
logistics.

### Installation

Expert installation delivers office-configured systems through certified professionals, ready for
deployment.

### Testing

Rigorous testing and quality control verify every system through walkthroughs and follow-up
inspections.

### Training

Flexible training builds confident teams through standard, certified, customized, and refresher
programs.

Proactive service and sustainment keep systems ready with maintenance, support, warranties,
modernization.

pulled.

video management, and command & control into one platform with minimal disruption to live
operations.

and integrator, we sustain systems for decades — protecting your investment and readiness.

Welcome to Aviation Parts World, a website that is owned and operated by ASAP Semiconductor. On this aviation-centered purchasing platform, you can find a plethora of new, used, obsolete, and hard-to-find items that cater to diverse applications, such as civil operations and more. To make the searching process simple, we have organized our expansive offerings into easily navigable catalogs that are based on part numbers, part types, manufacturers, NSNs, and much more. If you already have an idea of what you require, you may also save time using our provided search engine and filters. Once you narrow down results and find items of interest, we encourage you to utilize our online RFQ service which will allow you to request quotes for your comparisons.
To ensure a rapid procurement process, our team members will always provide you with a response to your request within 15 minutes of receiving and reviewing your completed form. Team members may also be contacted by phone or email at any time, and we would be more than happy to assist you however possible. Fully dedicated to our customers’ needs, you may also be treated to expedited shipping speeds, highly competitive prices, and short lead times to keep your operations running smoothly and efficiently. Furthermore, we enact various quality assurance measures for our inventory so that you always receive parts that are of the highest caliber. Get in touch today and see why so many customers steadily rely on our services for all of their operational needs.

# BunkerWeb, the open-source and next generation web application firewall (WAF)

## Make your web services secure by default

Fool attackers and protect your web services with our open-source Web Application Firewall.
BunkerWeb acting as a shield in front of your web services, it blocks attacks before they can hit
and guarantees condidentiality, integrity and availability of your data.

[ Read the doc ][27]
[ 1min Video ][28]

## Web security without any hassle

Placed as a reverse proxy while offering Web Application Firewall (WAF) functionalities, the
BunkerWeb solution integrates seamlessly into your existing infrastructure to secure your web
services.

BunkerWeb will help you defend against common web threats such as those listed in the OWASP Top 10,
block malicious bots, mitigate DDoS attacks and much more…

Use the solution as a single entry point for your web services and easily manage your HTTPS
certificates, incoming traffic from external sources, and security policies related to the HTTP
protocol. In other words, the security of your websites, applications and APIs is no longer a
hassle.
* Seamless integration into your existing infrastructure
* Reverse proxy with built-in security features
* Open-source solution auditable by a third party
* Fully configurable to meet your needs

### Integrations

More info on how to install BunkerWeb on Linux, Docker and Kubernetes in [our documentation][29]

[ Github repository ][30]
[ Join our discord ][31]

### AGPLv3 free license

## An open-source solution

Distributed under the AGPLv3 free license, the solution’s core code is entirely auditable by a third
party and the community. Unlike the opaque “black boxes” available on the market, we’ve made the
choice of transparency and peer validation. In other words, we advocate for open security over
security through obscurity. Do not choose the shadows anymore, discover the light.

Why Choose Open Source?
* **Total Transparency:** accessible source code ensures maximum trust and security
* **Active Community:** benefit from global collaboration with users worldwide
* **Sovereignty:** keep control and ownership of your data
* **Customization:** tailor the software to meet your project’s specific needs

Do not choose the shadows anymore, discover the light.

[ Github repository ][32]
[ Plugins list ][33]
Our Vision

### Transparency

BunkerWeb places transparency at the core of its solution, allowing users access to clear, open
code. This approach ensures uncompromised security and offers full visibility into every protective
mechanism in place.
Our mission

### Auditability

BunkerWeb’s auditability enables users to verify and assess the security measures applied. By
providing open access to code and configurations, BunkerWeb facilitates regular audits, enhancing
compliance and trust.

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

CSSI

A leader in engineered asset protection using composite material technology.

# Advanced Fire, Ballistic & Impact Protection SolutionsEngineered Ceramic Composite Panels Designed
# to Protect Critical Assets

CSSI delivers engineered protection solutions backed by proven research and unmatched material
performance. We combine proven technical expertise with advanced ceramic composites that offer
exceptional [fire][13] and [ballistic resistance][14], structural integrity, and long-term
durability, even in the most demanding environments.

[Our clients][15] include architectural and engineering firms, utility contractors, public and
private utilities, defense contractors, data management companies, and government agencies. We work
closely with our customers to develop tailored composite solutions to protect their critical,
sensitive, and valuable assets.

## Why Choose CSSI?

### Customizable Sizes and Designs
* Modular lightweight panels (320 lb.) for easy handling and installation.
* A standard wall (35 feet L x 30 feet H) can be installed in one day.
* Short manufacturing time, 4–6 weeks, and 3–4 months for large orders.
* Permanent or deployable wall systems available.
* Designed and manufactured in the USA.

### Reduction in Time, Labor and Costs
* Material costs are typically in line with precast concrete options.
* Panels are installed quickly, saving time and reducing labor costs.
* Freight and shipping costs are lower than those for concrete wall systems.

### Environmental Responsible Panels
* Panels are manufactured using sustainable technology.
* Manufacturing and shipping related CO₂ emissions are reduced when compared to concrete wall
  systems.

## Ceramic Composite Panel Benefits
* Firewall panels are formed to include air pockets for superior thermal insulation and fire
  resistance.
* Internal air pockets of ballistic panels are filled with sand or pea gravel to absorb and
  dissipate energy from gunshots and ballistic projectiles.
* Steel columns, casings, and nuts are protected using composite materials.
* Designed to minimize load-bearing impact at the base of the wall.
* Panels exceed government and private industry tests for strength and impact.
* No maintenance needed.
* Earthquake proof.
* Walls can be installed in extreme cold climates and withstand severe weather and harsh
  environmental conditions.

## Protecting Critical Infrastructure from the Ground Up

Let’s get started on a composite wall solution for you today.

## Security breaks when firewall policy breaks.

Enterprises don’t lack cybersecurity tools. They lack control.

Policies are scattered across firewalls, clouds, and segmentation tools, creating blind spots,
drift, and compliance gaps that attackers exploit.

#### FireMon brings it back together.

## How we stop policy from undermining security:

[Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud][Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud]

### Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud

FireMon serves as the system of record for network security policy. It normalizes and governs
firewall rules across on-prem and cloud environments, giving teams a single place to manage policy
for safer and controlled change.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,

### Frequently Asked Questions

What are industrial switches, and how do they differ from regular switches?

Industrial switches are specialized networking devices designed for harsh environments. They offer
higher durability, extended temperature ranges, and advanced features like redundancy and enhanced
security compared to standard switches. This makes them suitable for applications in manufacturing,
transportation, and other industrial settings.

What types of industrial switches does SanSo Network offer?

SanSo Network provides a range of industrial switches, including unmanaged, managed, and PoE (Power
over Ethernet) switches. Our product lineup caters to various networking needs, from basic
connectivity to advanced network management features.

Are SanSo industrial switches compatible with other networking equipment?

Yes, our industrial switches are designed to be compatible with a wide range of networking equipment
and protocols. They support standard Ethernet and can integrate seamlessly with other devices in
your network infrastructure.

Prevention-First Cybersecurity

# Know More.
# Miss Less.

Intrusion is a prevention-first cybersecurity company. Most security stacks detect threats after
they're inside and alert you once the damage is underway. We take a different position: we see every
connection moving in and out of your network and block bad traffic before it becomes a breach.

Here you'll find the Shield platform, the Global Threat Engine that powers it, and the
prevention-first approach behind both.

[See How Shield Works][31] [Run a Proof of Value][32]

## WHAT YOU CAN'T SEE *WILL HURT YOU.*

When was the last time your stack showed you everything leaving your network?

Packet sampling. Encrypted traffic. Outbound blind spots. Misconfigured firewalls. Unmanaged devices
nobody bothered to patch.

Every gap is a door. Every door is a way in, and a way back out for exfiltration. Most security
stacks accept this as the cost of doing business.

**Shield doesn't.**

It sees every connection, then blocks the ones that shouldn't be there. Both directions. No
sampling. No baselining. No exceptions.

## No Learning Curve. No Grace Period. No Waiting.

Shield protects from the second it's deployed. No 30-day baseline. No tuning window. No "let's see
what normal looks like." The [Global Threat Engine][33] has been building IP and DNS reputation
since 2001. 8.5 billion combinations today. Shield checks every connection against it and drops the
malicious ones autonomously, in-line, both directions.

[See How Shield Works][34]

[Shield blocking ransomware connection]

## Three Things Detection-Only Platforms Can't Say.

Most security stacks watch and wait. Shield blocks. That difference shows up three ways.

### We Don't Detect. We Block.

Detection tells you something bad already happened. Shield stops the connection before the threat
lands. No alerts. No incident response. No "lessons learned" memo.

### Built By Us. Since 2001.

The Global Threat Engine isn't a licensed feed or a community share. 8.5 billion IP and DNS
combinations. Built by Intrusion, owned by Intrusion, sharper than anything you can subscribe to.

### Inbound. Outbound. In-Line.

Most platforms watch one direction and hope. Shield enforces both. Drops into your existing
architecture in minutes. No agent on every device. No backhaul. No drama.
